svg.title: Bitcoin price versus IBIT weekly net inflows
svg.desc: The green line shows weekly IBIT net fund flow in US dollars, with red points for outflows. The blue line shows the corresponding Bitcoin closing price.
svg.text: Bitcoin Price vs. IBIT Weekly Net Inflows
Friday-ending weeks · Green line: IBIT net flow · Blue line: BTC close
Sources: The Block (IBIT daily net flows); Yahoo Finance (BTC-USD). Generated 2026-09-27 UTC.
